note: Repository neutral-point estimates in the aircraft-data frame (x aft of the wing leading-edge datum, m). Estimates, not measurements; each entry names its derivation. Used only by mass_balance_report.py to express static margin per fuel state.

jensen-das-ugly-stik-60.source: 43.5 % of the 0.3048 m chord: research/flight-dynamics/climb-trim derive_pitch_reference.py (Helmbold slopes, tail q-ratio 0.9, Raymer fuselage term; band 42.5-44.5 %, VLM 44.4 %); docs/research/flight-dynamics/climb-trim/README.md
jensen-das-ugly-stik-60.applies_note: The generated APC 13x6 variants share their base aircraft id, so they inherit this entry; the synthetic electric fixtures keep an earlier aero reference and are not covered.

gp-extra-300s-60.source: 42.5 % MAC derived from the Extra aerodynamic model (research/extra-300/ex05/derivation.md, model z 0.0381 m; aircraft-data x uses the aft-positive conversion). Current loaded full-tank CG is 25.99 % MAC, giving 16.47 % MAC static margin; the estimate is not a flight measurement.

p51d-mustang-120.source: 34.2 % MAC glide neutral point (research/p51/p51-05/derivation.md) with plan CG 27 % MAC: plan_cg x 0.177763 + 0.072 x MAC 0.508816 (taper formula)

sebart-avanti-s-a200-p100rx.source: manual aft CG 260 mm taken as 3 % MAC stable (research/avanti-s/av06/inputs.json): 0.260 + 0.03 x MAC 0.362193 (taper formula)

turbo-lumber-evolution.source: TT-07 derive_physics.py: generated static_margin=(xnp-cg_x)/c; current estimate 0.260304661 MAC at CG x=0.060 m and c=0.210293891 m gives xnp=0.114740480 m. Estimated aerodynamic neutral point, not flight identified.

moonrunner-x99.source: X8-06: ARP 425 mm from the nose plus -Cma/CLa = 0.3333/4.3993 of the 0.3571 m S/b chord (Low-Hansen et al. 2026 flight identification, research/skywalker-x8/X8-06/derive_physics.py), 452 mm from the nose, within 1 mm of the transferred tunnel neutral point (docs/research/skywalker-x8/X8-01/README.md); the tailless strip law reproduces it (X8-04). Not flight measured.
